fi: Pehmeä: 6–7 min kiehuvassa. Kova: 9–12 min. Jäävesi jälkeen. Keittiöpaketti, ei pilveä.

en: A large hen egg is about 50 grams.
Start in already-simmering water for more even whites.

q.en: About how many minutes for a hard-boiled egg at a simmer? (9–12 is fine)

explain.en: Hard-boiled is about 9–12 minutes, then an ice bath.
